subject.title: Support installing all skills/plugins from a publisher

question: Should the first publisher-wide workflow install skills only, or should ClawHub also orchestrate OpenClaw’s plugin installer?
rationale: Skills currently have a complete ClawHub installation path, while plugin installation belongs to the OpenClaw CLI; combining them establishes a new cross-product ownership, consent, and failure-handling contract.

options.title: Skills Only First
options.body: Enumerate eligible publisher skills and reuse the established ClawHub installer separately for each item.

options.title: Cross-CLI Orchestration
options.body: Define a supported OpenClaw plugin-install interface, compatibility handling, consent model, and rollback behavior before supporting both artifact families.

options.title: Discovery Only
options.body: List all publisher artifacts and print explicit individual installation or download commands without bulk mutation.

recommendation.title: Skills Only First
recommendation.body: Enumerate eligible publisher skills and reuse the established ClawHub installer separately for each item.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick has the strongest combined product and implementation history for this exact CLI area.
